title.en: Design a half adder from its truth table
Build a full adder from two half adders and an OR gate

say.en: Every calculator and computer adds numbers with a few logic gates. In binary, 1 plus 1 equals 10: a sum bit and a carry bit. Today we build the circuit that does it. In this lesson: Define a combinational logic circuit.
Design a half adder from its truth table.
Build a full adder from two half adders and an OR gate.

title.en: Combinational circuits and the half adder

body.en: In a combinational circuit the output at any instant depends only on the present inputs; it has no memory. A *half adder* adds two bits A and B and gives a sum S and a carry C. From its truth table, $S = \bar{A}B + A\bar{B} = A\oplus B$ and $C = AB$, so it needs one XOR gate and one AND gate.

points.en: *Half adder*: S = A ⊕ B (XOR), C = A·B (AND)
It cannot accept a carry from a previous stage

narration.en: A half adder adds two bits. The sum is A XOR B and the carry is A AND B, so one XOR gate and one AND gate are enough.
narration.kn: ಅರ್ಧ ಸಂಕಲಕ ಎರಡು ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಕೂಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೊತ್ತ A XOR B, ಕ್ಯಾರಿ A AND B. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಒಂದು XOR ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು AND ಗೇಟ್ ಸಾಕು.

say.en: A half adder adds two bits. The sum is A XOR B and the carry is A AND B, so one XOR gate and one AND gate are enough. Combinational: output equals fpresent inputs, no memory.

say.en: Half adder: S equals A ⊕ B XOR, C equals A B AND.
It cannot accept a carry from a previous stage.
Adding two bits has only four cases. Write the truth table: 1 plus 1 gives sum 0 and carry 1.
The sum is 1 when the inputs differ, which is XOR. The carry is 1 only when both are 1, which is AND.
So the half adder is just an XOR gate and an AND gate fed by the same two inputs.
A full adder adds a third bit, the carry-in. Two half adders do the adding and an OR gate joins their carries.
Check one row: 1 plus 1 plus 1 is 3, which is 11 in binary. The circuit gives sum 1 and carry 1.

body.en: A *full adder* adds three bits: A, B and the carry-in $C_{in}$ from the previous stage. Its outputs are $S = A\oplus B\oplus C_{in}$ and $C_{out} = AB + BC_{in} + AC_{in} = AB + C_{in}(A\oplus B)$. It can be built from two half adders and one OR gate: the first half adder adds A and B, the second adds its sum to $C_{in}$, and the OR gate combines the two carries.

points.en: Inputs A, B, Cin; outputs S, Cout

narration.en: A full adder also takes the carry-in. Its sum is the XOR of all three inputs, and its carry is AB plus Cin times A XOR B.
narration.kn: ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಕಲಕ ಕ್ಯಾರಿ-ಇನ್ ಅನ್ನೂ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೊತ್ತ ಮೂರೂ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗಳ XOR; ಕ್ಯಾರಿ AB + Cin(A⊕B).

heading.en: Sum is odd, carry is majority

body.en: For any adder, the sum bit is 1 when an odd number of inputs are 1 (that is XOR), and the carry is 1 when at least two inputs are 1 (a majority vote).

problem.en: A full adder has A = 1, B = 0 and Cin = 1. Find S and Cout using the equations.

steps.en: Check: 1 + 0 + 1 = 2 = 10 in binary, so S = 0 and Cout = 1.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A full adder has A = 1, B = 0 and Cin = 1. Find S and Cout using the equations.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A full adder has A equals 1, B equals 0 and Cin equals 1. Find S and Cout using the equations.
A ⊕ B equals 1 ⊕ 0 equals 1.
S equals (A ⊕ B) ⊕ Cin equals 1 ⊕ 1 equals 0.
Cout equals AB plus Cin(A ⊕ B) equals 0 plus 1 1 equals 1.
Check: 1 plus 0 plus 1 equals 2 equals 10 in binary, so S equals 0 and Cout equals 1.
So the answer is S equals 0, Cout equals 1.

problem.en: From the half adder truth table, write the sum-of-products expression for S and simplify it.

steps.en: S = 1 in rows A B = 0 1 and 1 0.
ĀB + AB̄ is the definition of A ⊕ B.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. From the half adder truth table, write the sum-of-products expression for S and simplify it.

say.en: Let us work this out together. From the half adder truth table, write the sum-of-products expression for S and simplify it.
S equals 1 in rows A B equals 0 1 and 1 0.
So S equals ĀB plus AB̄.
ĀB plus AB̄ is the definition of A ⊕ B.
So the answer is S equals ĀB plus AB̄ = A ⊕ B.
